title: Success probability of the halting-coin verifier
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, choose a random bit string of length $32(|x|+1)^2$ by independently setting each bit to $1$ with probability equal to the halting coin and to $0$ otherwise. The probability that the verifier's output equals the Boolean indicator of membership of $x$ in the halting language is at least $2/3$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a finite bit string
caveat: The supplied definitions do not informally describe the encoded procedures that determine the verifier and halting language, although the probability distribution and length are explicit.
